summary: Full E2E test of MesureEscalier app (backend + Expo web preview). 27/27 backend pytest cases pass after fixing two ReportLab PDF bugs. Frontend: login (3 demo accounts), dashboard with role-based UI, project create form, project detail with transmit/delete actions, technicien empty state all working. Vert Pomme accent + dark theme rendered correctly. RBAC verified on both API and UI levels.

issues: Console warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow); expo-av deprecated in SDK 54 (migrate to expo-audio/expo-video); props.pointerEvents deprecated. Non-blocking but to be cleaned up before production.

action_items: (Already fixed by tester) PDF export was returning 500 — ReportLab Table has no getStyle() method. Refactored build_pdf_bytes to use a shared TableStyle object instead of t.getStyle().
Address deprecation warnings (shadow* → boxShadow, expo-av → expo-audio/expo-video, props.pointerEvents → style.pointerEvents) when convenient.
Consider adding a dedicated /api/transcribe smoke test on a tiny audio fixture; currently only auth/empty-key branches were exercised indirectly.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py file is ~900 lines — could be split into auth/projects/measurements/exports modules for maintainability.
Duplicated TableStyle creation pattern in PDF builder is now consolidated (fix applied).
compute_stair correctly raises HTTPException 400 on invalid hauteur (good).

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows (login, dashboard, create project, RBAC FAB visibility, navigation, logout)

seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 3 demo users at startup. Tests created TEST_-prefixed projects/users which were cleaned up after the run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend has all endpoints fully functional including PDF/DXF export and integration site endpoint. Frontend Expo web preview at https://stair-pro.preview.emergentagent.com loads correctly. testIDs are well-applied: demo-admin/commercial/technicien, new-project-fab, modal-input-{nom,prenom,address,cp,city,phone,notes}, modal-submit-project, btn-transmit, delete-project, header-team, header-logout, dashboard-search-input, filter-pill-{tous|brouillon|a_mesurer|a_verifier|valide}. The measure wizard (3-step) and export screen were not exercised by Playwright but their underlying APIs are 100% green.
rca_of_issue: PDF 500: ReportLab's Table class does not expose getStyle(); the original code instantiated a TableStyle inline inside setStyle() then attempted to reuse it via t.getStyle() for two more tables, which raised AttributeError on every PDF export. Fix: hoisted the TableStyle into a `table_style` variable used by all three Table objects.
